steps.title: Aliquot RNA and DNA samples
steps.instruction: After nucleic‑acid extraction, make two RNA aliquots and three DNA aliquots per sample. Use one RNA aliquot for library preparation and sequencing, keep the second as a backup. Use the first DNA aliquot for library preparation, keep the second as a DNA backup, and reserve the third DNA aliquot for whole‑genome amplification (WGA) with the Illustra GenomiPhi DNA Amplification Kit (GE Healthcare, catalog #25‑6600).

substeps.instruction: Create two RNA aliquots; allocate one for library prep, one as backup.
Create three DNA aliquots; allocate first for library prep, second as backup, third for WGA.

steps.title: Dilute and denature DNA
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 ng of the third DNA aliquot in 25 µl sample buffer, then denature the mixture for 3 min at 95 °C.

steps.title: Cool samples on ice
steps.instruction: Place the denatured DNA tubes on ice to cool.

steps.title: Set up WGA reaction
steps.instruction: Add reaction buffer containing random hexamers to bring the volume to 22.5 µl, then add 2.5 µl Phi29 enzyme mix (Illustra GenomiPhi kit). Incubate the mixture at 30 °C for 3 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add reaction buffer with random hexamers to a final volume of 22.5 µl.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate Phi29 polymerase
steps.instruction: Heat the amplified reaction for 10 min at 65 °C to inactivate Phi29 DNA polymerase.

steps.title: Reduce hyperbranched DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the amplified DNA with RepliPhi phi29 DNA polymerase (Epicentre) without any primer at 30 °C for 2 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add RepliPhi phi29 DNA polymerase (no primer) to the amplified DNA.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate enzyme
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction for 3 min at 65 °C to inactivate the enzyme.

steps.title: Purify DNA with GenFind
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using the Agencourt GenFind V2 System, then resuspend the purified DNA in 200 µl elution buffer (catalog #A41497).

substeps.instruction: Perform purification with Agencourt GenFind V2 System.
Resuspend the purified DNA in 200 µl elution buffer.

steps.title: Clean up reaction
steps.instruction: Clean up the reaction again with the Agencourt GenFind V2 System following the manufacturer’s protocol, omitting the lysis step.

substeps.instruction: Execute GenFind V2 cleanup as per protocol.

steps.title: Store DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the final DNA preparation at –20 °C until further use.
